item.description:

Tropical Weather Outlook
NWS National Hurricane Center Miami FL
800 PM EDT Sat Oct 10 2026

For the North Atlantic...Caribbean Sea and the Gulf of America:

Active Systems:
The Weather Prediction Center is issuing advisories on
Post-Tropical Cyclone Isaias, located inland over northern Alabama.

Tropical cyclone formation is not expected during the next 7 days.

$$
Forecaster Adams

item.title: Summary for Post-Tropical Cyclone Isaias (AT4/AL092026)
item.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
item.description: ...FLASH FLOODING RISK CONTINUES WITH ISAIAS AS IT MOVES TOWARDS TENNESSEE... As of 10:00 PM CDT Sat Oct 10 the center of Isaias was located near 35.0, -86.7 with movement NE at 16 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1009 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 25 mph.

item.title: Post-Tropical Cyclone Isaias Forecast Discussion Number 18
item.description:
Issued at 1000 PM CDT Sat Oct 10 2026 
000
WTNT44 KWNH 110235
TCDAT4
 
Post-Tropical Cyclone Isaias Discussion Number  18
NWS Weather Prediction Center College Park MD   AL092026
1000 PM CDT Sat Oct 10 2026
 
Key Messages:
 
1. Heavy rainfall associated with Post-Tropical Cyclone Isaias will
continue across the Southern Appalachians and Southeast tonight.
Considerable flash and urban flooding will be possible. Landslides
are also possible across the Southern Appalachians.
 
2. Strong wind gusts continue to pose a threat across the
southeastern United States today, particularly near the southern
Appalachians. Scattered power outages and downed trees and
powerlines may occur, with the risk highest in elevated terrain.
 
3. Swells from Isaias will continue to affect much of the Gulf
coasts of the United States, Mexico, and western Cuba this weekend.
These swells are likely to cause life-threatening surf and rip
current conditions. Please consult products from your local weather
office.
 
4. A couple of tornadoes are possible tonight across eastern Georgia
and the Carolinas.
